Package io.webagent4j.crawler.internal

package io.webagent4j.crawler.internal
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.webagent4j.crawler
    The deterministic, sequential HTTP crawler engine: a java.net.http.HttpClient fetcher, jsoup link extraction, a breadth-first frontier, URL normalization/deduplication/scope policy, and redirect/retry handling - no browser, no JavaScript execution.
    io.webagent4j.crawler.api
    Backend-neutral HTTP crawler contracts - depends only on webagent4j-common: no HTTP client, no HTML parser, no Playwright.
  • Class
    Description
    BreadthFirstCrawlFrontier
    FIFO frontier: tasks are polled in exactly the order they were enqueued.
    CrawlTask
    One pending unit of work in the frontier: a normalized URL to fetch, at a known depth, with enough provenance to build a CrawlPageProvenance once fetched.
    HttpResponseClassifier
    Stateless HTTP status code classification.
    ICrawlFrontier
    Deterministically orders pending CrawlTasks for the crawl loop to process.
    InMemoryCrawlDeduplicator
    LinkedHashSet-backed ICrawlDeduplicator: sequential, single-crawl, single-thread use only - InMemoryCrawlDeduplicator.tryClaim(java.net.URI) is not safe for concurrent callers.
